source_caption: Friday (1995) is a cult comedy that follows two friends spending a chaotic day in their South Central Los Angeles neighborhood. Starring Ice Cube as Craig and Chris Tucker as Smokey, the story revolves around them trying to come up with money after Smokey accidentally sells a local drug dealer’s stash. Directed by F. Gary Gray, the film is known for its hilarious dialogue, memorable characters like Deebo, and its laid-back portrayal of one crazy Friday.
